hooks.command: if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}" ] && [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.agents/scripts/security_gate_v2.py" ]; then python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.agents/scripts/security_gate_v2.py"; elif [ -f scripts/security_gate_v2.py ]; then python3 scripts/security_gate_v2.py; elif [ -f .agents/scripts/security_gate_v2.py ]; then python3 .agents/scripts/security_gate_v2.py; else g="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ -n "$g" ] && [ -f "$g/.agents/scripts/security_gate_v2.py" ]; then python3 "$g/.agents/scripts/security_gate_v2.py"; else python3 .agents/scripts/security_gate_v2.py; fi; fi
